name: NOAH
description: A technical operator at the community radio station who works on signal equipment and antenna installation during an emergency broadcast operation. Noah is practical, capable with mechanical systems, and maintains a dry sense of humor under pressure.

Noah works seamlessly with Aria, June, and Kell across multiple scenes, responding to requests and coordinating on technical tasks without friction.
